title: Apprentice Priestess
overview: Main is now an apprentice priestess at the cathedral. How will she adapt to a new life in new surroundings, and how will they react to her?

title: Blue Robes and Uncommon Sense
overview: The stark contrast of the values at the church compared to life downtown continues to bewilder Main, as she butts heads with her retainers and her expected duties at the church.

title: Needs
overview: With Fran now fully on her team, Main must then get to work on winning Gil and Delia over.

title: Orphanage Reforms
overview: Main is taken to the orphanage and collapses in shock when she sees the state it and its inhabitants are in. She wants to help the kids, but will she really be able to?

title: Cleanups and Star Festivals
overview: As newly appointed orphanage director, Main's first task is to lead a major cleanup of the orphanage and its inhabitants. And as summer comes around, she also has some festivities in mind.

title: The Path Ahead of Lutz
overview: The friction in Lutz's family caused by his choice of profession comes to a head, and he runs away from home to get away from it all.

title: New Retainers
overview: When Main hears that Eva is pregnant, she decides to make a picture book for the baby and looks to recruit Wilma to be her artist. However, she finds a few roadblocks on her path...

title: Wilma and Holy Scriptures for Kids
overview: With the picture-book production in full sway, Main must navigate several hurdles regarding the process and, more pressingly, Wilma's condition.

title: Harvest Festivals and Staying Home
overview: The Harvest Festival is here, and Main finds the library ransacked. She is outraged at first, but this may be a welcome opportunity for her...

title: Knight Orders and Requests
overview: Main has to break the news to her family that she has to stay in the cathedral over winter. Meanwhile, the request from the knight order looms large over the horizon.

title: Trombe and Battles
overview: Main and the head priest set out to join the knights on a mission to take down a rampage trombe. With this being her first exposure to proper noble society, who knows what perils lie in Main's path?

title: Dreamlike World
overview: Tasked with healing the land ravaged by the trombe, Main has to put on a show. How that will affect the way the onlookers see her is anybody's guess... and so is how the head priest will react.
